GrandMasterRegister — ROLE & TXT EXPORT CONTRACT
Version: 1.1
Status: REGISTRY CONTRACT

GrandMasterRegister is the authoritative catalogue/relationship registry for EDEN identities.
It contains Apps, Products, Workspaces, Specialists, Helpers, Tiny Helpers/Tiny Apps, Agents, subordinate Helpers, Modules, Capabilities, Providers and other registered entity types/relationships.

AppDevRules and edenOSrules DO NOT duplicate this list.
Their integration with GrandMasterRegister is USER OPT-IN.

Canonical registry fields include where applicable:
canonical_id; canonical_name; symbol; short_form; expanded_name/title; functional acronym meaning; conceptual meaning; behavioral metaphor/personality; entity_type; role; purpose; scope; authoritative ownership; capabilities; boundaries/non-goals; commands/modes; parent/family; subordinates; relationships; standalone_capable; embedded_capable; provider/execution modes; status; version/revision; availability; legacy aliases; supersedes/superseded_by; provenance; confidence; visual metadata.

Relationship types may include:
parent; module_of; subordinate_of; capability_provider_for; invoked_by; available_to; depends_on; integrates_with; representation_of; supersedes; superseded_by; legacy_aliases.

TYPE = what the thing is.
CAPABILITY = operation.
PROVIDER = implementation.
INSTANCE/CONNECTION = configured installation/account/device.
Provider != connection.

Private build requirement:
Provide a synchronized human-readable GrandMasterRegister.txt export of the authoritative registry.
Do not maintain the TXT export as an independent competing registry.
